scenario.title: Strategy, current plans and initiative closeout
situations: The user describes a large effort without a durable plan.
The existing CURRENT-PLAN is stale or contains accepted standing decisions.
Most linked work is done and the user wants to finish the initiative.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Current skill/doc semantics were read; strategy mutation and archive behavior were not exercised.
Should a completed Blitz receive the same scope/evidence audit before its existing automatic archive?
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.

lessons.title: Reuse direction and change only approved strategy
lessons.when: When strategy is absent, placeholder, stale, or the user asks to change project direction.
lessons.need: CURRENT-PLAN holds near-term outcomes; strategy rows are authority and local files are renders. Reuse accepted content and propose changes before writing.
lessons.surface: Onboard strategy step; Strategize proposal/approval phases; Strategy page
lessons.gap: Review question: should JOURNEYS 9-10 distinguish a focused first-work plan from a full five-document strategy review? Current Onboard requires five accepted docs.

lessons.title: Staff a plan through Steer
lessons.when: When an accepted plan has runnable work with no owner, or the user asks to pursue that plan.
lessons.need: Read the selected plan, live work state and covering authority before staffing; preserve standing decisions and update the durable checkpoint. Reconcile contradictory teaching about Feed versus Steer rather than inventing an extra mandatory step.
lessons.surface: Steer entry, scope and loop; public Strategy guidance
lessons.gap: Public Strategy says strategy needs Feed to become runnable work; current Steer says not to invoke Feed, while Strategize attributes staffing to the scheduler. Review question: which shipped owner governs each role, and which producer texts must change together?

lessons.title: Close the initiative separately from ending a session
lessons.when: When linked work is nearly complete or the user asks whether the initiative can be archived.
lessons.need: Audit delivered scope, evidence and tracked deferrals before archiving an initiative. A session wrapup or steering-seat release answers a different question.
lessons.surface: JOURNEYS completion proposal; existing Steer close-out and Wrapup
lessons.gap: JOURNEYS 15 names no current initiative-audit home. Review question: how should it coexist with Blitz automatically archiving its execution document on successful done?
